subject: VPC deployment topology confirmation, SOC 2 status & questionnaire
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@medex.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: VPC deployment topology confirmation, SOC 2 status & questionnaire

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the security checks and what your team can hand back:

1) Compliance posture you mentioned: please confirm current SOC 2 status (In progress / Type II expected date), and whether MedEx requires HIPAA BAAs or additional contractual language for PHI handling.

2) Deployment preference: you indicated a strong preference for a customer-managed VPC (Redwood Private VPC) with a transit gateway peering pattern. Can you confirm whether the final environment will be in AWS us-east-1 and whether you plan to host the model nodes in the same VPC as your application?

3) Air-gapped constraints: you noted an internal airgap for training artifacts only; production inference should remain reachable. Please describe (bullet points) any strict egress restrictions or outgoing allow-lists we should know about.

4) Evidence and docs we need to move the security review forward:
   - Latest SOC 2 report or SOC 2 in-progress confirmation + expected Type II date
   - Network diagram (L2/L3) showing where Redwood instances will sit and egress points
   - Any existing vendor questionnaire answers (we've attached our vendor questionnaire to start)

I attached our vendor questionnaire and a simple network-diagram template to speed things up. Ideal next steps: you share the network diagram + SOC timeline by EOD Wednesday (2026-07-21), and we will schedule a 30-min SRE/Network sync with Tom to validate routing and firewall rules.

If you prefer, Rishi can pick this up and lead the technical review — marked him on cc.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
[Attachment: redwood-vendor-questionnaire-v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: requested-network-diagram-template.vsdx (vsdx)]

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@medex.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medex.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T17:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC deployment topology confirmation, SOC 2 status & questionnaire

Jonas — thanks for the summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: We completed a first SOC 2 Type I in 2025; Type II is in progress and expected by 2026-10-15. We can share the Type I report now; Type II timeline is firming up with our external auditor.
- HIPAA: We handle PHI in a limited scope for a subset of customers. We do require a signed BAA for any system that stores or processes PHI.
- Deployment: yes, primary region is us-east-1. We prefer Redwood instances to be in a dedicated subnet inside our analytics VPC with strict host-based firewalling.
- Airgap: our air-gapped environment applies to dataset curation and model training; inference must be reachable from our web tier. Egress is allowed only to a small set of destinations (we'll provide the list).

I'll attach the Type I SOC report and our internal network diagram draft. Tom will coordinate the SRE availability for a deep-dive — he can meet Tue/Wed next week.

I'll upload the diagram and the SOC Type I to the link below by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sarah

--
Sarah Lee
CISO, MedEx Health
sarah.lee@medex.com | +1 617-555-0789
[Attachment: medex-soc2-type1-2025.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@medex.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medex.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC deployment topology confirmation, SOC 2 status & questionnaire

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Sarah — that sounds good. Two quick items before the SRE sync: 

- Can you drop the preliminary egress allow-list (CIDRs/hostnames) into the Drive link you mentioned? That will let Rishi validate our outbound health-check & telemetry endpoints.
- On the BAA: I'll escalate to our legal counsel and loop back with a draft BAA; we can include the standard HIPAA appendix and any MedEx-specific clauses you require.

Rishi — can you review the network diagram template I attached and flag any missing pieces we should ask MedEx to include before the SRE meeting? Key things: control-plane endpoints, NAT/egress hosts, shared services IP ranges, and any 3rd-party peering points.

I'll propose two 30-min slots on Wed (07/21) 9:00am PDT or 2:00pm PDT for the SRE session. Tom, let us know which works.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@medex.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medex.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC deployment topology confirmation, SOC 2 status & questionnaire

Thanks — quick read-through notes from my side (pre-sync):

- Network diagram: please ensure the diagram labels the subnet CIDRs, NAT gateway IPs (or egress appliance), and peering attachment IDs. Also add an explicit control-plane security group that lists our healthcheck IPs; I will provide the small set of IPs to allow.
- TLS/Mutual TLS: If you plan to terminate mTLS at a load balancer, call that out; we can support mTLS from our inference nodes to your LB.
- Data classification: please flag any datasets that are PHI — we will treat those with BAA controls and ensure disk encryption + customer-managed keys where required.
- Questionnaire: we reviewed the vendor questionnaire and added comments on section 3 (key management) and section 7 (retention). Sarah — if you can answer the questionnaire items we flagged it will speed up the legal review.

I'll join the SRE session on Wed 07/21 at 2:00pm PDT. Jonas — please send the calendar invite with a short agenda (diagram review, egress allow-list, BAA next steps).

-Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0398
